comment: Low-resolution page index: what verses are on what pages, for pages outside the high-resolution line-break index (0072B-0085B). de_archive_spread is the number in the archive.org BookReader URL .../page/n<N>/mode/1up, and equals the jp2 file number download_cam1753_spreads.py uses. An entry carries de_text_at_end or de_text_at_start depending on which end of the column was read.

de_note: Read off the images by Ben, 2026-08-04. The page is labelled 107 in pencil and קז in Hebrew numerals, which is what pins de_archive_spread to the BookReader n number with no offset.
